title: How To Start Fasting: Just Skip Breakfast
hook: The easiest way to get started with intermittent fasting is to just skip your breakfast.
body: Keep everything else you're eating throughout the day the same, and drink black coffee to help with the hunger. You can eat a little bit more later and it will still work, but if you eat all the calories you were going to eat at breakfast later, you're defeating the purpose. Say you normally eat lunch at noon: move it back to 12:30 until you're comfortable and not hungry, probably about 30 days, then move it back to one o'clock, and keep going until you're fasting five hours in the morning. If you wake up at 9 a.m. like me, you eat lunch at two.
close: Leave a comment to let me know if you've tried skipping breakfast yet.
youtube_description:
The easiest way to get started with intermittent fasting is to just skip your breakfast.

Keep everything else you're eating throughout the day the same, and drink black coffee to help with the hunger. You can eat a little bit more later and it will still work, but if you eat all the calories you were going to eat at breakfast later, you're defeating the purpose. Say you normally eat lunch at noon: move it back to 12:30 until you're comfortable and not hungry, probably about 30 days, then move it back to one o'clock, and keep going until you're fasting five hours in the morning. If you wake up at 9 a.m. like me, you eat lunch at two.

Leave a comment to let me know if you've tried skipping breakfast yet.
